fixes.what: Drop the `img` half: keep will-change on the four layer divs only. GSAP force3D promotes the img for the 0.9 s bounce and demotes it after.
fixes.why: Eight resident full-width RGBA textures (≈26 MB each at 1440×DPR2, plus the masked bark/sprig layers) is the one real scroll-jank risk on integrated GPUs; four is enough.

fixes.what: Wrap each sentence in its own span (`Honoring the roots. Elevating the vibe.`) with `display:inline-block`, and remove the balance rule.
fixes.why: index-phone-0.jpg shows the line breaking at 'ELEVATING / THE VIBE.', not at the full stop the CSS comment promises.
Clearing the inline style leaves GSAP's `_gsap` transform cache holding the quickSetter y, so the first rotation write after Play-after-Pause re-renders the stale offset.

fixes.what: Listen for `invalid` (capture) on the form: set `aria-invalid="true"` and a `.field__error` message linked by `aria-describedby` on the failing field; clear it on `input`.
fixes.why: Native validation bubbles vanish after a few seconds and VoiceOver on iOS does not announce them; the gold-underline inputs have no persistent error state.

fixes.what: Move the margin tweaks into two or three utility classes in site.css (e.g. `.mt-16`, `.mb-32`, `.h2--tight`).
fixes.why: A `style-src` CSP without 'unsafe-inline' silently drops them, and the spacing rhythm lives in two places.
